description: The claude_native_outside_writer frame the desktop agent publishes for one outside-writer state change of an adopted Claude Code session (claude_session_probe.go claudeOutsideWriterFrame; pinned by claude_session_probe_test.go). terminal-service records it only when agentId and uid name that session's own computer and owner (adoptedSessionClaims.service.js recordOutsideWriter), so a reader test should feed it this frame rather than a hand-built one. version and bootId are examples: every build and agent process sends its own.
